summary.name: Ihor Medvediev
summary.description: I am an experienced IT professional with a strong background in analytical problem-solving. I am a full-stack developer with knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js. I have completed all my projects using the Agile/Scrum methodology and strictly adhering to deadlines. I have excellent interpersonal skills and take a proactive approach to solving problems. I am a fast learner, responsible, and always ready for new challenges. I am looking for opportunities to contribute to a dynamic and innovative IT team.

education.title: A FEW WORDS ABOUT ME
education.motivation: Your determination and perseverance define your future. Never give up!
education.description: Hello everyone, my name is Igor. I’m from Kyiv, Ukraine. Currently, I live and work at Vysočinské nemocnice in Humpolec, Czech Republic, where I’ve been for the past 4 years. I graduated from Medical University in 2012 and started my medical career shortly after. However, in 2021, I developed an interest in single-page website development. Realizing I needed more structured knowledge, I took a course in HTML/CSS. What began as a hobby quickly became a passion and guided my decision on my future tech stack. I then completed a year-long Full-Stack Developer course from January 20, 2023, to February 14, 2024, and will receive a certificate. At the moment, I have more than a year of practice and have 8 projects in my portfolio, both team and individual.

FirstProject.description: Pet project. Website fors watching movies. Has header, main, footer. The header contains the logo and navigation, the main contains the main content, and the footer contains links to social networks. On the site you can view not only information on the selected film, but also actors and reviews.

SecondProject.description: Awesome commercial project. Website for taking and studying tests. Has header, main, footer. The header contains the logo and navigation, the main contains the main content, and the footer contains links to social networks. To date, the page has been accessed 40 400 times, according to Google Search Console!

ThirdProject.description: Team project. „TaskPro“ web application with user registration. Works with the server database to store tasks. Adaptive layout. Role: developer - FrontEnd. „TaskPro“ is a user-friendly task board that helps teams organize tasks and track progress effortlessly. Its intuitive design enhances collaboration and productivity, making project management smooth and efficient.

FourthProject.description: Team project built with pure (vanilla) HTML and CSS, with minimal use of JavaScript. Indulge in the finest handcrafted chocolates and have a variety of exquisite flavors delivered right to your door.

FifthProject.description: Team project. Welcome to TastyTreats — your online haven for culinary discoveries! Explore a world of delicious recipes from around the globe, where you can discover, cook, and connect with fellow food lovers! The website includes a header, main, and footer. Features include sorting, adding to Favorites, and a shopping cart.

SixthProject.description: Pet project: a website for browsing and searching images based on a given theme. The site features API integration and pagination, offering a beautiful, lightweight, and elegant project for my portfolio.!

SeventhProject.description: Pet project. A phonebook for recording phone numbers with options to create and edit entries. It also includes a search feature. The project is built with React using hooks.

EighthProject.description: Pet project: „MyPortfolio“ website detailing my work experience, completed courses, and all my projects with links to GitHub and live pages.
